_help: Each source is one place Bon Temps checks for events. type: tribe (WordPress 'The Events Calendar' sites), jsonld (pages with built-in event data), ical (calendar feeds), saffire (Saffire venue sites), eventlinks (a page linking to one page per event; links is a pattern for those links), wixsitemap (Wix sites: reads upcoming event pages from the sitemap), mecrest (WordPress Modern Events Calendar sites), sheet (published Google Sheet of submissions), squarespace (Squarespace event pages), downtown (Downtown Lafayette event pages), lcg (Lafayette city government calendar), lafayettetravel (Lafayette Travel event pages from its sitemap), page (AI reads the page; currently unavailable), ticketmaster (needs TICKETMASTER_API_KEY). Set enabled to false to turn one off. venue is used when an event doesn't say where it is. cats adds categories to every event from that source; fallback is used only when an event matches no category. maxDays drops listings that run longer than that many days (open-ended 'weekly' listings).

sources.name: The Lafayette Mom
sources._note: Turned off: mostly kids' and library events.

sources.name: Acadiana Center for the Arts (all events)
sources._note: Every event page the site lists, so shows further out are included.

sources.name: Lafayette Travel
sources._note: The tourism bureau's full calendar read from the event pages in its sitemap. To avoid clutter it only adds big kinds of events (require: festivals, parades, concerts, holiday shows, fairs...), never classes or business meetings (skip). yield: when a venue or organizer lists the same event, theirs wins, even if the dates disagree. Events with more than maxDates dates (weekly regulars) are skipped. Each run opens at most pagesPerRun new or changed pages, 2 seconds apart. The Actions log lists everything it adds ('events only it lists') and warns above warnAbove.

sources.name: Happening Next (Lafayette live music)
sources._note: Third-party listings site; covers Feed N Seed, Warehouse 535, Rock'n'Bowl and other clubs.

sources.name: Cité des Arts
sources._note: Theater, comedy and classes. Reads upcoming event pages listed in the site's sitemap.

sources.name: Lafayette city government
sources._note: LCG's public events calendar. Routine business (regular council and commission meetings, office closures, classes) is skipped so only bigger public events show.

sources.name: Ragin' Cajuns home games
sources._note: UL Athletics' public all-sports calendar feed; only home games ("vs", played in Lafayette) are kept. The site asks for 30 seconds between requests, so it's read once per run.

sources.name: Submitted
sources._note: Rows from the site's Submit an event form. Only rows with Approved = yes are published.

sources.name: Cajundome
sources._note: Reads each event page linked from the Cajundome's events page. Ragin' Cajuns games are skipped here (their times sometimes disagree with UL's own feed, which covers them), as are box office and office notices, graduations and job fairs.

sources.name: Rock'n'Bowl de Lafayette
sources._note: Wix site: reads upcoming event pages from its sitemap. The sitemap also lists the New Orleans Rock'n'Bowl, so only events at the Lafayette address are kept.

sources.name: Parish Brewing
sources._note: Still off: its events load with JavaScript from another service, and it has no public feed (checked Nov 2026).

sources.name: Lafayette Public Library
sources._note: The library's public LibCal calendar (about 500 events). To avoid clutter only special events are kept (concerts, author visits, films, festivals, holiday events: 'require'), never regular programs like storytime, LEGO club or classes ('skip'), and nothing that repeats more than twice in two months ('maxRepeats').

sources.name: Blue Moon Saloon
sources._note: The public 'Subscribe' iCal feed from the venue's Timely calendar.

sources.name: Artmosphere
sources._note: Wix site; events load with JavaScript.

sources.name: Wonderland Performing Arts
sources._note: Reads upcoming event pages from the site's sitemap. Happening Next also lists some Wonderland shows.

sources.name: UL Lafayette Dance & Theatre
sources._note: UL's calendar loads with JavaScript and its data feeds are off. UL performances (Angelle Hall, Burke Theatre) come in through Happening Next's performances and theatre pages.

hide._help: Events whose title matches any of these patterns (case doesn't matter) are left out. Add a word or phrase to hide more.
patterns: ^(?:rock ?'?n'? ?bowl|blue moon saloon|hideaway on lee|feed (?:n|and|&) seed)[^a-z]*(?:de lafayette)?[^a-z]*(?:lafayette,? la\.?)?$

_bigEventsHelp: Big yearly events Bon Temps should never miss. usually: month-day it normally starts (or mardigras-N: N days before Mardi Gras). Starting leadDays (default 45) before that date, if no listing matches 'match', the collector opens a GitHub issue (GitHub emails you) so you can add the dates by hand.
_venueNamesHelp: venueNames: street address -> venue name, for listings that only give an address. The collector also learns these from listings that include both.

quality._help: Events listed ONLY by these aggregator sites are kept when they're music, theater, food or arts, have a public-event word in the title (keepWords), or are at a known venue (any venue another source covers, plus knownVenues below). Everything else (seminars, office parties, kids' camps) is left out. The Actions log lists what was left out each run.

photos._help: Pictures you add yourself, like a flyer someone texted you. Save the image in docs/img/ (on GitHub: open the docs/img folder, Add file, Upload files), then add an entry: match is part of the event's name (case doesn't matter), image is the file's path. It replaces any other picture for every listing whose name matches. Add credit (and creditUrl) for photos that need one, like Creative Commons photos; it shows under the picture.

_trendingHelp: Pages whose featured events count as popular for Top picks (marked 'hot'). type jsonld: the page's event data; type links: event links on the page (pattern picks out the name).

topPicks._help: Events that should always be in Top picks (when they're within the coming week), whatever the automatic ranking says. match is part of the event's name (case doesn't matter).
